lines: Unproved by never spreading — though knowing-clad and all —
breath and kin rank knowable, never knower. Else, straying.
sanskrit_cite: na siddho 'prathanād eva jñānādisamavāyy api tat prāṇādi prameyaṃ syān na pramātānyato bhramāt

lines: Though things stand locked in the living,
by breath and eightfold-city curbed — even there, in the supreme self it dwells.
sanskrit_cite: yady apy arthasthitiḥ prāṇapuryaṣṭakaniyantrite jīve niruddhā tatrāpi paramātmani sā sthitā

lines: How could breath ever prove its hold on that self-nature?
In recognition — by living-ness, past non-showing.
sanskrit_cite: tadātmanaiva tasya syāt kathaṃ prāṇena yantraṇā sādhitā pratyabhijñāyām akhyāter jīvatā param
notes: line 2 nominal, mirroring verbless SA close (akhyāter jīvatā param)

lines: No ordering of things lies in breath by I-blocking —
shining's self-rest is sung as I-ness.
sanskrit_cite: nārthavyavasthā prāṇādāv ahaṃbhāvanirodhataḥ prakāśasyātmaviśrāntir ahaṃbhāvo hi kīrtitaḥ

lines: Rest, already told — that very rest, all dependence barred:
freedom, foremost doing, and lordship in its train.
sanskrit_cite: uktā saiva ca viśrāntiḥ sarvāpekṣānirodhataḥ svātantryam atha kartṛtvaṃ mukhyam īśvaratāpi ca
notes: both lines nominal, mirroring verbless SA (uktā … īśvaratāpi ca)

lines: Māyā by name, from his power only — no other proved:
this world-maker lordship is made of non-showing.
sanskrit_cite: māyābhidās tacchakter eva cānyāprasiddhitaḥ tadakhyātimayaṃ hy etaj jagannirmātṛteśitā

lines: Through linking alone is she proclaimed — of all awarenesses
the mother-reality, self-feeling's own name — beginningless.
sanskrit_cite: ekaiva cānusaṃdhānāt sā proktā sarvasaṃvidām svasaṃvedanaparyāyamātṛtattvam anādi tat
notes: line 2 nominal, mirroring verbless SA (proktā … anādi tat); mother-reality for mātṛtattva, against L2's mother-principle

lines: Whatever grounds thing-ordering — pervasion and linking
of the I-sharer — fits nothing inert.
sanskrit_cite: bhāvavyavasthā yan niṣṭhā tasyāhaṃbhāvabhāginaḥ vyāpitvam anusaṃdhānaṃ taj jaḍasya na yujyate

lines: So within difference, shining's shining holds good —
hence recognition's word: this world is that-nondual-made.
sanskrit_cite: tato bhede tu bhāsasya ghaṭate bhāsamānatā tenoktam pratyabhijñāyāṃ tadadvayamayaṃ jagat
notes: shining's shining keeps the SA's own bhāsa-figure (bhāsasya bhāsamānatā)
